scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/types && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test --workspace=e2e
scripts.test:e2e:ui: npm run build && npm run test:ui --workspace=e2e
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: npm run build && npm run test:smoke --workspace=e2e
scripts.test:e2e:journeys: npm run build && npm run test:journeys --workspace=e2e
scripts.test:e2e:coverage: rm -rf e2e/.coverage e2e/coverage && E2E_COVERAGE=1 npm run build && E2E_COVERAGE=1 npm run test --workspace=e2e
